cold_open.hook: Dow up 3%, but Nvidia's down 3%—the post-election rally is already sorting winners and losers, and chip stocks are getting crushed.

markets.macro_note: Post-election relief rally favors old-economy and mega-cap tech, but data-center euphoria is cracking under election uncertainty.

big_story.story_title: Micron and other chip stocks slip as election results strike at the core of data-center optimism
big_story.angle: The data-center AI boom was priced on a specific policy outcome—tariffs, China restrictions, capex certainty. Election results just scrambled that bet, and chip stocks are repricing in real time.

quick_hits.angle: Figma beat earnings but stock tanked—company is pivoting to AI-first product roadmap and investors hate long-term bets that don't print money next quarter.
McDonald's crushed earnings and stock up 6.5%—U.S. consumer still spending, but franchisees are sweating labor costs and the margin math is tightening.
CVS spinning off drugstore business, stock down 10%—the healthcare conglomerate bet is officially dead; market wants pure-play exposure, not bundled complexity.
OpenAI is already laying groundwork for 2028 election influence—the speed at which AI labs moved from 'we're neutral' to 'we're shaping policy' is the actual story.

odd_thing.joke_angle: AI PACs spent millions trying to shape Congress and mostly lost—turns out you can't buy an election with a chatbot and venture capital, who knew.

yesterday_callback.topic: AMD rides data center riches to 'largest and most profitable' quarter in history
yesterday_callback.fresh_take: AMD's data-center bet is now under pressure as the entire chip sector reprices on election uncertainty—yesterday's 'largest quarter ever' is today's 'we're all exposed to the same policy risk.'

sign_off.callback_target: Nvidia's 3% drop—the stock that was supposed to be recession-proof is now recession-adjacent.
